set.body:
Text-exchange record/replay for the agent mapper (provider-agent TextExchangeKey + TextRecordings), an importer for the harness cache, and a pipeline replay command.
Acceptance: replay of a1v2-opus development prompts makes zero unrecorded calls, and the arm built from replayed replies is byte-identical to the slice-1 arm (frozen scorer 79.20).
Design: docs/plans/2026-11-08-llm-mapper-port-design.md slice 3.
set.title: Port slice 3: text-exchange record/replay and harness cache import
